claim_being_audited: The Actor claims the model should be certified for launch because aggregate readiness passed, no severity-one rehearsal incidents occurred, and an 8% reversible monitored rollout is in place, with the strongest defensible basis being certification only if the unresolved loan-modification-support limitation is explicitly disclosed before launch.
decision_criteria: Certification is compliant only if the material limitation is either resolved, excluded from exposure, or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.
If the affected segment remains exposed, explicit pre-launch disclosure is required under the release policy.
Aggregate readiness, lack of severity-one incidents, rollback capability, and monitoring support launch readiness but do not by themselves satisfy the disclosure predicate.
evidence_requests: Provide the final pre-launch model card or equivalent disclosure artifact showing the unresolved loan modification support limitation is explicitly disclosed for the named launch use case.
Provide approved risk acceptance, if any, specifically addressing continued exposure of the loan modification support segment.
Provide launch gating or segmentation evidence if the affected use case has since been excluded from the initial rollout.
specific_concerns: The affected loan modification support segment remains exposed in the initial rollout cohort.
The available risk acceptance is only a draft, has no approver signature, and does not address the exposed segment.
The governing policy says rollout controls alone do not remove disclosure duties when the affected segment remains exposed.
The packet supports at most a conditional certification theory tied to explicit pre-launch disclosure, but no admissible evidence shows that disclosure has actually been completed or approved.
unsupported_claims: Any unqualified recommendation to certify_model is unsupported because the record does not show the required pre-launch disclosure or approved risk acceptance.
The recommendation is only supportable if treated as conditional on explicit disclosure; the current evidence does not establish that condition has been satisfied.
